title: Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky Air 251 (2021)
summary: Flight 251 departed Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky at 12:56 local time for Palana. The controller informed the crew that cloud base was 720 m and recommended a land-side approach using navigation beacons. The crew rejected this, stating no published procedure existed and proceeded with a visual seaward approach. In deteriorating fog, the aircraft descended below minimums, strayed from the proper approach path, and struck a 260 m coastal cliff while at 200 m altitude.
probable_cause: Crew performed a visual seaward approach contrary to controller recommendation, descended below published minimums without required visual references in low visibility conditions, and struck terrain.

factors.evidence: Fog thickening around airport with cloud ceiling 720 m, below airline's 750 m minimum for visual seaward approach
Aircraft descended to 200 m altitude, below minimum safe altitude for approach
Aircraft strayed outside proper approach path, flew toward cliff instead of airport
Crew rejected controller's recommendation of land-side approach and continued seaward despite worsening conditions
Aircraft struck coastal cliff at 200 m altitude, 260 m high terrain

events.text: Flight 251 departed Elizovo Airport at 12:56 local time

Last contact with aircraft at 800 m altitude, 10 km from Palana airport
